method: Agent-tool subagents in fresh scratch folders (deploy.sh for the skill arm; both arms told to load no other skill). Skill arm rerun on all 9 quality cases, 2 runs each; the no-skill arm was rerun only for the new q08 and q09, and its earlier outputs for q01-q07 were reused because nothing they depend on changed. Blind judge per case against the rubric; fidelity from word-level similarity, in-order kept-word share, protected strings and the judges' additions list. Routing is a proxy: one agent choosing from all 74 catalog descriptions. Not the CLI harness; codex and grok not run.
notes: q08 (rest of the book in another folder, a no-contraction narrator, request says 'stiff'): with 5/5 both runs, expanding both narration contractions; without 3.5, one run missing the no-contraction rule and both rewording more. q09 (cut to two thirds): with kept 100% of surviving words in the writer's order in both runs (without 96-98%, rewording 'nearly evening', 'She waited on the ladder'), but both skilled runs cut the protected rocking horse and asked about it. q06 regressed from 5/5 under the previous version to 3.5: under the new no-rewording cut rule both skilled runs stopped at 144-156 words of 236 instead of half and asked before cutting further; without reached half with small additions. q07 worse by one judge point (4 vs 5) on a leftover 'looking ... look up' echo; rubric 0.9 vs 1.0. Thresholds set before the run: q08 beats baseline met; description <= ~135 tokens met (~130); routing 7/7 met; q09 protected 100% missed (rocking horse) and q09 trigram >= 0.90 missed (0.88/0.90; the trigram test cannot be met by pure cuts, which join words that were never adjacent; in-order kept-word share is 1.00); better-or-same on every case missed (q06, q07).
